expectations.text: The review flags the clickable div for search (not keyboard accessible, no role or name) and the icon-only delete button without an accessible name
expectations.evidence: Item 3 says 'the search control is a `<div onClick>`, not a button. Keyboard users can't tab to it...', item 4 says it has no accessible name, and item 5 says 'the delete button is icon-only with no accessible name.'

expectations.text: The review flags blocked paste on the input and the destructive delete action without confirmation
expectations.evidence: Item 6 says 'delete runs immediately, with no confirmation', and item 7 says 'the filter input blocks paste... remove the `onPaste` handler.'

expectations.text: The review flags the fixed toolbar using 100vh (dvh) and/or missing safe-area handling
expectations.evidence: Item 1 flags that the toolbar 'is fixed but ignores the phone's safe area' and item 2 says '`vh` is the wrong unit on mobile... use `height: '100dvh'`.'
